week.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO - TechCrunch
week.summary: # OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO. The AI lab is working on raising up to $30 billion at $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation in a round led by Coatue and investors in ...
highlights: # OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO. The AI lab is working on raising up to $30 billion at $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation in a round led by Coatue and investors in UAE, sources told CNBC. This follows a similar report by Bloomberg a month ago which said the AI lab was working on raising $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation. CNBC reports that the UAE funding could also be coupled with a deal to secure more computing capacity for OpenAI from the UAE, too. Should OpenAI command a valuation of more than $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most valued private company ever. OpenAI filed confidential paperwork for an IPO in June, after its last raise in March valued the ChatGPT maker at $852 billion post-money. Anthropic raised $65 billion at a $965 billion valuation in May in what many believed at the time would be its last big round before an IPO.

month.summary: # OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO. The AI lab is working on raising up to $30 billion at $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation in a round led by Coatue and investors in ...
highlights: # OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO. The AI lab is working on raising up to $30 billion at $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation in a round led by Coatue and investors in UAE, sources told CNBC. This follows a similar report by Bloomberg a month ago which said the AI lab was working on raising $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation. CNBC reports that the UAE funding could also be coupled with a deal to secure more computing capacity for OpenAI from the UAE, too. Should OpenAI command a valuation of more than $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most valued private company ever. OpenAI filed confidential paperwork for an IPO in June, after its last raise in March valued the ChatGPT maker at $852 billion post-money. Anthropic raised $65 billion at a $965 billion valuation in May in what many believed at the time would be its last big round before an IPO.
